author: oscarbenjamin

entries.text: Removed workarounds in Basic.xreplace, Basic.subs, Basic.replace, Basic.sort_key, and Basic.doit that allowed non-Basic objects in the args of a Basic instance. Downstream Basic subclasses that have non-Basic args may now raise errors in these methods (they should be fixed so that all args are Basic).
